blocks.text: On the first day of each quarter (Jan 1, Apr 1, Jul 1, Oct 1), the security team will generate a list of all users with access to production systems.
This list will be sent to each department manager. Managers are required to review the list and confirm that each user still requires production access.
Any access that is no longer needed must be explicitly marked for revocation. The security team will process all revocations within 5 business days.
